definitions.explanation: Eyeglasses worn to correct vision or for protection.

examples.japanese: {眼鏡|めがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
{眼鏡|めがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけています→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
{眼鏡|めがね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}えません→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I can't see without my glasses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{眼鏡|めがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。

{眼鏡|めがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけている→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦かけていません→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Many people wear glasses, but I have good eyesight so I don't wear them.

notes:
{眼鏡|めがね} uses the verb ⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to put on, to wear) rather than ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (for clothing). Often written in hiragana as めがね in casual contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {眼鏡|めがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put on/wear glasses
- {眼鏡|めがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off glasses
- {眼鏡|めがね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧: glasses don't fit/suit (prescription is wrong)
- {眼鏡|めがね}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: optician, glasses shop

TYPES:
- ⟦{老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}→老眼鏡：19227_rougankyou⟧: reading glasses
- ⟦{伊達|だて}{眼鏡|めがね}→伊達眼鏡：19709_datemegane⟧: non-prescription glasses (fashion)
- ⟦サングラス→サングラス：04535_sangurasu⟧: sunglasses
